text: hospital heart monitor beeping twice then one long flatline tone, clean, close
old hospital nurse call bell ringing, harsh electric buzzer ring repeating in an empty corridor
squeaky wheelchair wheels slowly rolling down an empty tiled hospital corridor, distant, creepy
old elevator arrival ding followed by heavy steel doors sliding open
steel elevator doors slam shut then deep mechanical hum of an elevator descending, dark
flickering fluorescent tube light buzzing and humming in a silent hospital room
